settings.heading: We build the website your business runs on.
settings.text: CHARGIX is a small studio that designs, builds and launches Shopify websites. Three fixed prices, paid online, built in English or Spanish.

settings.text: Shopify stores and service sites, designed for your brand, set up properly and tested on phones before launch.

settings.heading: Keep it running.
settings.text: Optional monthly care for Shopify sites. Shopify handles hosting and security; we do the human checks and the edits.
settings.desc_1: Monthly health check, 30 minutes of edits, reply within 3 business days
settings.desc_2: Twice-monthly checks, 2 hours of edits, reply within 1 business day
settings.desc_3: Weekly checks, 3D checks on every device, 4 hours of edits, same-day reply
settings.fine: Extra work is always quoted first, at $65/hour.

settings.q: Is the 3D in the $1,650 package real 3D?
settings.a: Yes. 3D Experience and Business Launch include one real, interactive 3D scene built with WebGL, with a lighter fallback for phones. The story at the top of this page is different: it is a pre-rendered animation that your scrolling plays forwards and backwards.
No. Essential is a clean, fast, professional website with no 3D. If you want 3D, choose 3D Experience or Business Launch.

settings.q: What do you need from me?
settings.a: After checkout you fill in a short project form and share your logo, photos and product information. Your timeline starts once those are in.
Your Shopify plan, domain, paid apps, photography and ad spend. We never guarantee sales, rankings or ad results.

settings.q: Do you need my Shopify password?
settings.a: No. We use Shopify collaborator access, which you approve and can remove at any time.
Yes, we work in English or Spanish. Business Launch also includes Spanish versions of your key pages.
See our refund policy for exactly when and how refunds work.
